title: Celebration '76 (Hand signed twice and warmly inscribed). Celebrating Fort Worth, Texas
medium: Offset lithograph poster. inscribed/dedicated in ink and signed twice by hand with artist's copyright. unframed.

events.n: published to celebrate America's bicentennial in Fort Worth
events.q: This rare Helen Frankenthaler offset lithograph was published by the renowned fine art publisher Tyler Graphics to celebrate America's bicentennial year - 1976 - in Fort Worth Texas.
